# Claude Code Environment Variables: UI and Terminal

These 95 environment variables of Claude Code `2.1.303` cover the terminal screen, colors, voice, keys, and notifications.
They change how Claude Code looks and sounds in your terminal.
An environment variable is a named setting that you put in your shell or in the `env` key of `settings.json`.

## Example

Run `export NO_COLOR=1` before `claude` to turn off colors.
Or put `{ "env": { "NO_COLOR": "1" } }` in `~/.claude/settings.json`.

## Variables

The marks are explained on the [index](Claude-Code-Env-Vars#marks).

| Name | Mark | What It Does | Value | Where It Works |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CLAUDE_AFK_COUNTDOWN_MS` | ✅ | Sets how long before auto-continue the countdown shows on an unanswered `AskUserQuestion` dialog. | A number of milliseconds, `20000` by default. Whole number, default `20000`, capped at the auto-continue timeout | Interactive UI. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_AFK_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅ | Sets the idle time before an unanswered `AskUserQuestion` dialog auto-continues. Setting it also turns auto-continue on. | A number of milliseconds. Whole number, overrides the `askUserQuestionTimeout` setting. The dialog shows when the value is not `undefined` | Interactive UI. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_AX_ANNOUNCEMENT_HOLD_MS` | 🔍 | Sets how long screen reader mode holds output after a hold request for an announcement. | A number of milliseconds, `1000` by default. Whole number of `0` or more, default `1000`, capped at `10000` | Screen reader mode. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS` | ✅ | Sets how long screen reader mode waits before it writes a new or changed line. | A number of milliseconds, `0` by default. Whole number of `0` or more, default `0`, capped at `5000` | Screen reader mode. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_AX_REWRITE_HELD_ANNOUNCEMENT` | 🔍 | Controls whether screen reader mode rewrites a held announcement. | On, off, or unset, `false` by default | Screen reader mode. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER` | ✅ | Turns screen reader mode on with `1` or forces it off with `0`. | On, off, or unset. The `--ax-screen-reader` flag wins, then this var, then the `axScreenReader` setting. Claude Code sets `1` for relaunched children | Interactive UI. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_AX_STARTUP_QUIET_MS` | ✅ | Sets how long screen reader mode holds the first render after the startup line. | A number of milliseconds, `3000` by default. Whole number of `0` or more, default `3000`, capped at `600000` | Screen reader mode. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ACCESSIBILITY` | ✅ | Keeps the native terminal cursor visible and turns off the inverted-text cursor. Screen magnifiers can then track the cursor. | On or off. Also stops Claude Code from hiding the cursor again after a suspend resume | Interactive UI. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ALTGR_AS_TEXT` | 🔍 | Controls whether AltGr key chords count as text input. | On or off. Truthy gives `force`. Falsy gives `off` | Interactive UI, mainly Windows Terminal. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ALT_SCREEN_FULL_REPAINT` | ✅⚠️ | Repaints the whole screen on each frame in fullscreen rendering. | On or off, on by default | Fullscreen UI. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_AUTO_OPEN` | ✅ | Stops Claude Code from opening the browser when it publishes an artifact. | Text. A falsy value such as `0` skips the open and logs `auto_open_skipped_env` | Artifacts. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_CONNECT_IDE` | ✅ | Overrides the automatic IDE connection. `false` stops it and `true` forces a try. | On, off, or unset. `false` wins over the `autoConnectIde` config | IDE integration |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_BRIEF` | 🔍🧪 | Turns on brief mode. In brief mode plain assistant text is hidden and only the user message tool reaches the user. | On or off. Else a feature flag decides. An entitlement check applies | All sessions, gated by a feature flag |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_BS_AS_CTRL_BACKSPACE` | ✅ | Sets whether the `0x08` byte counts as Ctrl+Backspace or plain Backspace. | On or off. A truthy value means Ctrl+Backspace and a falsy value means Backspace. Else it is Ctrl+Backspace on Windows except `mintty` and `cygwin` | Terminal input |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_REPAINTS` | 🔍 | Turns on the repaint debug mode of the terminal renderer. | On or off, off by default. Copied to the Ink root node as `debugRepaints` | Terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DECSTBM` | 🔍🧪 | Forces the DECSTBM scroll region renderer on. Without it an internal flag decides. | On or off. Truthy string. Off when the terminal check fails or other renderer conditions apply | Fullscreen terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN` | ✅ | Uses the classic main-screen renderer instead of fullscreen. | On or off. Also triggers when `CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER` is false. A startup crash hint names it | Terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY` | ✅ | Turns off the "How is Claude doing?" session surveys. | On or off. Checked in the survey and memory survey gates | Interactive UI. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LAUNCH_COMPOSER` | 🔍❌ | In the schema, but nothing reads it. | On or off | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE` | ✅ | Turns off mouse tracking in fullscreen rendering. | On, off, or unset. A set truthy value gives mouse mode `off`, a set false value gives `full` | Fullscreen terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS` | ✅ | Turns off click, drag and hover handling but keeps wheel scrolling. | On, off, or unset. A truthy value gives mouse mode `scroll`. `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE` wins when set | Fullscreen terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NOTIFICATION_PRESENCE_CHECK` | ✅ | Sends the `PushNotification` desktop notification even when the user is typing or the terminal has focus. | On or off. Skips the presence check in the tool | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` | ✅ | Turns off automatic terminal title updates and the title generation request. | On or off. Also stops the `claude` process title write | All sessions. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_VIRTUAL_SCROLL` | ✅ | Turns off virtual scrolling in fullscreen rendering, so every message renders. | On or off, off by default | Fullscreen terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY` | ✅ | Forces session recaps on or off, ahead of the `awaySummaryEnabled` setting. | On or off. Off values give off, on values give on. Else off in non-interactive mode, and the setting decides otherwise | Interactive. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_LAUNCH_COMPOSER` | 🔍❌ | In the schema, but nothing reads it. | On or off | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_MENU_KIND_LANES` | 🔍🧪 | Turns on kind lanes in the slash command menu. | On or off, off by default. Else a feature flag | Interactive slash menu |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION` | ✅🧪 | Forces prompt suggestions on or off, ahead of `promptSuggestionEnabled`. | On, off, or unset. Unset needs a feature flag, then the setting. `true` also stops the unused-suggestion auto-pause | Interactive. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_FIRST_RENDER` | 🔍 | Skips startup prefetches and fullscreen auto-switch checks so the process can exit after the first render. | On or off, off by default | Interactive startup, used for startup tests |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_FOOTER_INDICATOR` | 🔍 | Sets a custom text for the footer indicator. | Text. Control chars are stripped and the text is trimmed. Wins over settings | Interactive footer |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_FIRST_LAUNCH` | 🔍 | It takes a date-like value or an on-style value and returns a `pretendLastSeen` object. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | On or off. Second env accessor. A date-like value gives that last-seen value, an on-style value gives an empty one | Interactive UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_FULLSCREEN_UPSELL` | 🔍 | Shows the fullscreen mode upsell even when other checks would skip it. | On or off, off by default. Still skipped in non-interactive mode and some other modes | Interactive |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_STRIKETHROUGH` | ✅ | Forces `~~text~~` strikethrough rendering in terminals that are not auto-detected. | On or off, off by default | Interactive terminal |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_SYNC_OUTPUT` | ✅ | Forces DEC 2026 synchronized output on. No effect under tmux. | On or off, off by default. Works for emulators that skip the capability probe | Interactive terminal |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_TERMINAL_IMAGES` | ✅ | Forces image output through the kitty graphics protocol. | On or off, off by default. Also used in the kitty graphics capability check | Interactive terminal, not tmux or screen |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_TIP_ID` | 🔍 | Forces the startup tip with this id to show. | Text, unset by default | Interactive sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD` | ✅ | Hides the working directory in the startup logo header. | On or off. Unset shows the path, with the remote name when one exists | Interactive terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_SETTINGS_HINT` | 🔍 | Hides a settings hint. A helper returns false when it is on. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | On or off. The hint is also off for the entrypoints `claude_in_slack`, `claude-in-teams`, and the `remote_*` ones | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_HOST_OVERRIDE` | ✅ | Overrides the host address Claude Code uses to reach the IDE extension. | Text, gateway by default. Unset gives `127.0.0.1`, or the default gateway IP when it runs in WSL | IDE integration, WSL |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_AUTO_INSTALL` | ✅ | Skips the automatic install of the IDE extension. | On or off. Works like `autoInstallIdeExtension` set to `false` | IDE integration. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_VALID_CHECK` | ✅ | Skips the check of IDE lockfile entries, so each entry counts as containing the working directory. | On or off | IDE integration |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES` | 🔍 | Sets the idle minutes before a `new task?` notification shows in a long conversation. | A number, `75` by default. Works with `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_TOKEN_THRESHOLD` | Interactive terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_TOKEN_THRESHOLD` | 🔍 | Sets the least conversation size in tokens before the idle `new task?` notification can show. | A number, `100000` by default. Works with `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES` | Interactive terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_KB_COHESION_FIXES` | 🔍 | A helper returns true when it is set and false otherwise. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | On or off | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_NATIVE_CURSOR` | ✅ | Shows the terminal's own cursor at the input caret instead of a drawn block. | On or off. Also on for accessibility modes. Unset follows a feature flag | Interactive terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT` | ✅⚠️🧪 | Makes `/init` run the interactive setup flow. Docs omit that the an internal flag also turns it on. | On or off. Changes the `/init` description and prompt | All sessions, `/init` |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_NONBLOCKING_STDOUT` | ✅⚠️🧪 | Writes terminal output through a second non-blocking descriptor so a stalled terminal cannot freeze the session. Docs omit the remote flag. | On, off, or unset. Passed as the env override. A feature flag also feeds the choice | Interactive terminal UI on macOS, Linux, WSL |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER` | ✅ | Turns on fullscreen rendering and overrides the `tui` setting. A false value turns it off. | On, off, or unset. Also forced on in background sessions and off by `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN` | Interactive terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_POWERUP_ONBOARDING` | 🔍🧪 | Shows the `/powerup` tour offer as a `banner` or a `step`, even after onboarding is done. | Text, `off` by default. Other values fall back to a feature flag, default `off` | Interactive sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_PROACTIVE` | 🔍 | Passes the value as `assistantMode` to the interactive loop. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | On or off | Interactive sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_RC_PERMISSION_NUDGE` | 🔍🧪 | Overrides the config of the Remote Control permission nudge. Fields are `afterPromptCount`, `probability`, and `maxImpressions`. | JSON text. Defaults are 5, 0, and 3. Without it a feature flag is used | Interactive sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_RELAUNCH_TERMINAL_SIZE` | 🔍 | Carries the terminal size across a relaunch as `COLUMNSxROWS`. The new process uses it when stdout reports no size. | A number. Set by Claude Code on relaunch. The new process removes it | Relaunched sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED` | ✅ | Sets the mouse wheel scroll multiplier in fullscreen rendering. Values above 20 are capped to 20. | A number. Parsed with a float. A non-number or a value of 0 or less falls back to the default of 1 or 3 by terminal | Fullscreen terminal UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SEND_FEEDBACK` | ✅🧪 | Turns Claude-drafted feedback off with `0` or on with `1`. It cannot grant access the account lacks. | On, off, or unset. Even when on, the check still needs a feature flag. First-party provider only | First-party API accounts. gated by a feature flag |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SILENT_TURN_REMINDER` | 🔍🧪 | Forces the silent-turn reminder on or off. The reminder nudges the model to update the user after a long quiet turn. | On, off, or unset. When unset, a gate function reads server and flag config for `silent_turn_reminder` | All. gated by a feature flag |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SILENT_TURN_REMINDER_SECONDS` | 🔍🧪 | Sets the quiet time in seconds before the silent-turn reminder fires. It overrides the server value. | A number of seconds. Integer 1 or more. Without it a server config number of 1 or more is used | All sessions. Related to the silent-turn reminder |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SILENT_TURN_REMINDER_TEXT` | 🔍🧪 | Overrides the text of the silent-turn reminder sent to the model. | Text, text by default. A feature flag may replace the default | All sessions. Related to the silent-turn reminder |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SILENT_TURN_REMINDER_TURNS` | 🔍🧪 | Sets the number of silent turns before the reminder fires. It overrides the flag value. | A number. Integer 1 or more. Else a feature flag value is floored, with a built-in default | All sessions. Related to the silent-turn reminder |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SSE_PORT` | 🔍 | Gives the port of the IDE extension. It turns on IDE auto-connect and marks the IDE lockfile with that port as a match. | A number. Integer. An IDE terminal usually sets it | IDE integration |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHT` | ✅ | Turns off syntax highlighting in diff output when set to a false value. The theme screen then shows it as disabled by this variable. | Text. A false value such as `false` turns it off. Docs match | Diff output |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_THINKING_DISPLAY_UPDATES` | 🔍 | Chooses whether connector-text updates show while thinking text is hidden. On gives `connector_text`, off gives `none`. | On, off, or unset, on by default. Ignored when the thinking display is `summarized`, `highlights`, or similar | Interactive UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_TMUX_PREFIX` | 🔍 | Holds the tmux prefix key. Claude Code shows it in the tmux session notice. | Set by Claude Code when it starts its own tmux session | `--tmux` sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_TMUX_PREFIX_CONFLICTS` | 🔍 | Marks that the tmux prefix is a key that Claude Code also uses. The notice then says to press the prefix twice. | On or off. Set by Claude Code to `1` or empty | `--tmux` sessions |

| `CLAUDE_CODE_TMUX_TRUECOLOR` | ✅ | Allows 24-bit color inside tmux. Without it, Claude Code clamps to 256 colors when `TMUX` is set. | `rawStr`. Any non-empty value counts, so `0` and `false` still allow truecolor | Terminal inside tmux |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_TUI_JUST_SWITCHED` | 🔍 | Tells the new process that the user just switched TUI mode. It shows the matching notice and skips the downsell announcement. | `fullscreen` or `default`. Removed from the environment when Claude Code relaunches itself | Interactive UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_TUI_TRIAL` | 🔍 | Starts a fullscreen trial when the value is `fullscreen`. Claude Code latches it once and then unsets it. | Text. Removed from the environment when Claude Code relaunches itself | Interactive UI |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅ | Sets the deadline for dialogs that Claude Code forwards to a remote client. It overrides the `dialogExpiry` setting. | A number of milliseconds. Integer, whole value. Order: env, setting, then `300000` | Remote Control and SDK hosts |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_VOICE_FORWARD_INTERIMS_TYPED` | 🔍🧪 | When on, a voice function returns true. Otherwise the an internal flag decides. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | On or off, comes by default | Voice input |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_YOU_SHOULD_KNOW_DEBUG` | ✅ | Shows a line above the prompt for each of the last three checks of the You should know mod. | On or off | Interactive sessions |
| `CLAUDE_FORCE_DISPLAY_SURVEY` | 🔍 | Forces the feedback survey to show if it never showed before. | On or off. Blocked by `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY` and the feedback policy | Interactive sessions |
| `CLIPBOARD_NAPI_NODE_PATH` | 🔍❌ | Would set the path of a native clipboard addon, but the loader returns `null` before it reads the var. | A path | - |
| `COLORFGBG` | 🔍 | Hints the terminal background. Claude Code maps it to a dark or light theme. | - | - |
| `DEMO_VERSION` | 🔍 | Replaces the shown version and the working directory in the header for demos. It also skips the release notes. | - | - |
| `DISABLE_COST_WARNINGS` | ✅ | Turns off cost warning messages. | On or off | - |
| `DISABLE_UPGRADE_COMMAND` | ✅🧪 | Hides the `/upgrade` command. | On or off. The command also hides for enterprise plans or when a feature flag is on | Interactive. Project `env` can set it before trust |

| `FORCE_HYPERLINK` | ✅ | Forces OSC 8 hyperlinks on or off. | A number. Parsed as a number. `0` turns links off and any other non-empty value, including `false`, turns them on | Terminal output. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `INK_SCREEN_READER` | 🔍 | Turns on screen reader mode in the terminal UI renderer. | - | - |
| `INTELLIJ_TERMINAL_COMMAND_BLOCKS` | 🔍 | If set to any value, marks the JetBrains terminal wheel and arrow scroll handling as bug-confirmed. | - | - |
| `INTELLIJ_TERMINAL_COMMAND_BLOCKS_REWORKED` | 🔍 | If set to any value, marks the JetBrains terminal wheel and arrow scroll handling as bug-confirmed. | - | - |
| `IS_DEMO` | ✅⚠️ | Demo mode: hides the account email and organization name in the header and status output. | - | - |
| `ITERM_SESSION_ID` | 🔍 | Detects iTerm2 and gives the session id that the iTerm2 pane backend uses for teammate panes. | Text | - |
| `KITTY_WINDOW_ID` | 🔍 | Detects the kitty terminal for terminal identification and strikethrough support. | Text | - |
| `KONSOLE_VERSION` | 🔍 | Marks Konsole as a terminal that supports strikethrough text. | - | - |
| `LANG` | ✅ | Gives the locale for date formatting. It is the last fallback after `LC_ALL` and `LC_TIME`. | - | - |
| `LC_ALL` | 🔍 | Gives the locale for date formatting, first in order. Claude Code also sets it to `C` for routed `sh` interpreters. | - | - |
| `LC_TERMINAL` | 🔍 | Detects iTerm2 when it is `iTerm2`, for macOS key and clipboard handling. | - | - |
| `LC_TIME` | 🔍 | Gives the locale for date formatting, after `LC_ALL`. | - | - |
| `MSYSTEM` | 🔍🧪 | On Windows, a set value marks the terminal as mintty (Git Bash). | - | - |
| `NETLIFY` | 🔍 | If set, the bundled hyperlink check says the terminal supports hyperlinks. | - | - |
| `NO_COLOR` | ✅ | Turns off colors unless `FORCE_COLOR` is set. | On or off | - |
| `TERMINAL` | ✅ | Names the terminal program that Claude Code starts on Linux for features that open a terminal window. | Text. Non-empty string. Tried first | Linux |
| `VISUAL` | ✅ | Sets the editor for external editing. It wins over `EDITOR`. | Text. Non-empty string. If neither is set, Claude Code tries `code`, `vi`, `nano` | All sessions |
| `VOICE_STREAM_BASE_URL` | 🔍 | The name is a typed string in the schema and appears in a list of names. Nothing reads it, and a [Probes](Claude-Code-Probes) run saw no effect. | Text | Unknown |
